BillHeading.BriefDescription: Increasing the availability of sexual assault nurse examiners.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing the availability of sexual assault nurse examiners; and adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) Subject to the availability of amounts appropriated for this specific purpose, the department shall establish a stipend program to defray the out-of-pocket expenses incurred by registered nurses completing the training necessary to become adult/adolescent or pediatric sexual assault nurse examiners.
(2) The total amount of the stipend for any individual nurse may not exceed $2,500.
(3) For purposes of this section, "out-of-pocket expenses" include:
(a) Fees, tuition, educational materials, or other charges imposed by the entity providing training;
(b) Reasonable travel expenses, including air travel, rental car costs, mileage on a personal vehicle, lodging, and meals; and
(c) Any other expenses deemed appropriate by the department.
(4) The department may adopt any rules necessary to implement this section.
